gui.visual-swap.title: Visual Swap
gui.visual-swap.preset.label: Preset
gui.visual-swap.effects.title: Toggles
gui.visual-swap.effects.hint: Hover a switch to see what it controls.
gui.visual-swap.effects.mod.label: Mod
gui.visual-swap.effects.mod.help: Master switch — turns the whole mod on or off.
gui.visual-swap.effects.hud.label: HUD
gui.visual-swap.effects.hud.help: Umbrella for the on-screen effects: the swap-hit glyph, hotbar highlight and item flash.
gui.visual-swap.effects.hotbar_highlight: Highlights the swapped hotbar slots — the From/To colour swatches tint it. Part of the HUD.
gui.visual-swap.effects.item_flash.label: Item Flash
gui.visual-swap.effects.item_flash.help: Flashes the clicked hotbar item's tint — what the flash-duration slider and rules below configure. Part of the HUD.
gui.visual-swap.effects.only_on_swap.hel: When on, the item flash only fires when you attack/use right after switching to the item (an attribute swap). When off, it fires on every matching attack/use.
gui.visual-swap.effects.particles.label: Particles
gui.visual-swap.effects.particles.help: The particle burst when a swap hit lands — the size slider scales it.
gui.visual-swap.rules.empty: No rules yet — use the + button above to add one
gui.visual-swap.rule_config.title: Rule Config
gui.visual-swap.rule_config.hint: Hover a setting to see what it controls.
gui.visual-swap.rule_config.strength.hel: How strongly the item is tinted when it flashes — Low keeps the item's own shading, High is a flat fill.
gui.visual-swap.rule_config.effects.help: Show the swap-hit glyph and hotbar highlight when switching to this item.
gui.visual-swap.preview.title: Matched items
gui.visual-swap.preview.origin.title: Swap origin
gui.visual-swap.preview.destination.line: item flashes in the active rule's

gui.visual-swap.confirm.discard.title: Discard changes?

gui.visual-swap.confirm.leave.body: You have unsaved changes. Leave without saving?
gui.visual-swap.confirm.delete_rule.body: Remove this rule from the table?
